implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.spawn_piece creates a Tetromino positioned at the top; Game.update advances gravity using get_drop_interval and move_down.
Game.move_left and Game.move_right check board.is_valid_position and adjust self.current_piece.x; input_handler maps LEFT/RIGHT keys to these methods.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player can rotate pieces before they land
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.rotate attempts a clockwise rotation with simple wall‑kick offsets and updates the piece's shape; UP key triggers rotate.
Game.soft_drop moves the piece down one cell and awards points; Game.hard_drop drops to the lowest valid position and locks the piece; DOWN and SPACE keys invoke them.
Board.clear_lines removes fully occupied rows and shifts above rows down; Game.lock_current calls this after locking a piece.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Scoring increases with cleared lines and drops
implemented_requirements.evidence: constants.LINE_SCORES defines points per line; Game.add_score applies these multiplied by level; soft/hard drop points added in Game.soft_drop and Game.hard_drop.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends when no more pieces can be placed
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.spawn_piece checks board.is_valid_position for the new piece; if invalid, self.game_over is set to True.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Board updates after each move or drop
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.is_valid_position validates moves; Board.lock_piece writes cells into the grid; Renderer draws the board each frame reflecting the current grid.

implemented_requirements.requirement: All seven standard Tetromino shapes are included
implemented_requirements.evidence: constants.SHAPES defines I, O, T, S, Z, J, L; PieceBag shuffles SHAPES.keys() and supplies them to Tetromino.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Increasing drop speed as the game progresses
implemented_requirements.evidence: constants.get_drop_interval returns a faster interval based on the current level; Game.level is increased in add_score after every 10 lines.

judge.summary: The provided source files implement a functional Tetris game meeting all core benchmark requirements. The board, piece logic, gravity, line clearing, scoring, level‑based speed increase, and input handling are all present and appear runnable with pygame installed. Minor polish (e.g., full SRS wall kicks) is absent but does not affect core functionality, so the submission passes.
